Description:
You step inside the magic circle, and an incantation of fire, frost, and lightning begins. The figure with robes and glowing eyes moves around, raw energy emanating from their palms. A book lays open on the floor, pages flipping themselves and shifting through bright violet runes. The circle is abruptly broken, and the magic stops, as you notice the Artificer caressing his beard, eyes all on you. Did the spell fail? Could this be a mistake? An error in the code of arcane? Artificers work in mysterious ways...
Artificers are channelers magic, refiners of the coarse arcane, directly from the source, who can transform those vibrations into elemental energies. Mastery over magics has made their spells fast and efficient, but in their choice of spells and invocations, no two Artificers are alike.
Wizards are in a continuous study of magic, and their mind is trained for accessing higher-order spells ahead of time, while sorcerers prefer a more random (albeit practical) usage of magic, going with the flow. Artificers are the complete opposite, however, prefering rigurious crafts of trial and error until they excel in their preferred creation field - alchemy, tinkering, even blacksmithing.

Weapons: You are Trained in a Weapon Category of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Artificer-specific Abilities are considered Spells (except Magic Mastery).

~Artificer~.Effect:
Spending {Gold}Gold for its components, design and assemble a mechanized apparatus capable of performing simple, repetitive operations such as illumination, sound emission, olfactory diffusion, or the projection of pigment to form crude symbols or imagery.
You can create any normal weapon, armor, non-food general good or adventuring gear item piece by spending its {Gold}Gold cost.
You can _dismantle_ any good into {Gold}Gold equal to its selling worth.
~Artificer~.Notes: You can't use them to deal Damage, crowd control or heal. Typically, items sell at 25% of their base cost, and magic items at 50% of their base cost. Feel free to be creative with what you can do - the tools might do other small artificer tasks as well. Ask your QM! The spent {Gold}Gold for this is used as resource for obtaining or transmuting materials.

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, manually add +1 to a Stat of choice. Go to My Character and click on the number you want to add or subtract from.

~Better Faster Stronger~.Effect:
You start with +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +3).

You have both an extra tier of Class Talents at Level 1.
~Better Faster Stronger~.Upgrade:
_Optimization through augmentation:_ the governing axiom of all Artificers. Every enhancement demands equivalence; every ascension a sacrifice. How much of your humanity will you surrender in pursuit of God?
Many Artificer Talents are conversions of your Sense into long-term, structural refinements, some of which can be gained over and over.

<Grenade>.Effect:
Create a grenade with one of the effects below.
Each effect has a different area size (centered on the grenade).
You can have up to 3 grenades created at a time.

A grenade can be thrown with 1 Action, up to 6 meters range.
SingleTable: 2x2 meters; Blinds all Units hit
3x3 meters; Units hit take 2d8 Smash Damage and are Slammed 4 meters away from the center
5x5 meters; the grenade explodes at the start of your next Turn for 2d10 Smash Damage to Units hit
6x6 meters; all Allies hit get a 1d4 Shielding and can instantly move 1 meter
<Grenade>.Notes:
Each grenade costs 50 {Gold}Gold to craft, but can be freely recovered and repaired after Combat.
Alternatively, you create the grenade and give it to an ally to use (throwable with 1 Action).
You can only have 3 grenades created at a time. You can destroy a grenae to create another one of a different type.

~Mobility Device~.Effect: Spend 200 {Gold}Gold to design a gyroscopically balanced locomotor platform, functioning similarly to a hoverboard or twin-wheel vehicle that gives the rider +1 Movement Speed.
~Mobility Device~.Upgrade: You can only have one mobility device created at any point.

~Force Field~.Range: 5 meters to any part of the field
~Force Field~.Effect:
Immediately raise a thin, 3-meter wide force field.
Any missile passing through the force field get -50% Damage.
~Force Field~.Upgrade: Units can't pass through the field, but it can be deliberately destroyed with a Half-Action.

~Autoturret~.Effect:
Deploy a simple autoturret on a space within 3 meters. It has a 3-meter range.
At the end of your Turn, each autoturret automatically attacks the closest enemy to it within range for 1d4 Pierce Damage.
~Autoturret~.Upgrade:
Each autoturret has 1 Health and costs 50 {Gold}Gold to craft, but can be freely repaired after Combat and carried in the pocket.
You can only have 3 autoturrets deployed at a time.

~Teleportation Zone~.Effect:
Throw a _teleportation pad_ or draw a _teleportation circle_ on a space.
At the start of your next Turn, teleport yourself or an ally near you to it.
~Teleportation Zone~.Upgrade: Beyond a range of 100 meters, the translocative processes may produce anomalous results.

~Toolbelt~.Effect: You possess compact Toolbelt engineered to provide immediate access to one of each Adventuring Gear piece costing at most 100 {Gold}Gold (except food).
~Toolbelt~.Upgrade: To pull out another tool, you must first put the previous tool back.
~Toolbelt~.Notes: If you lose the pulled item, you can get another copy next Adventure.

~Weaponized Arms~.Effect:
Spend 100 {Gold}Gold to fabricate a specialized arm sleeve capable of securely housing and concealing up to 3 weapons inside.
One may rapidly draw and sheathe any of the weapon at will with the move of a finger.
You can only have one special sleeve created at a time.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

~Bionic Eye~.Effect:
Execute a precision operation to integrate a bionic eye into an Ally (or yourself).
The subject gets {Brown('-1 Sense')}, but gains +3 Health Regen, have no penalty for attacking in the dark, can record visuals with the eye, and gains +2 in Sight (or a similar Non-Combat Skill).
~Bionic Eye~.Upgrade: This +2 in Sight can go higher than the Stat Limit.
~Bionic Eye~.Notes: {StatLimit}. Only one operation can be conducted per eye.

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, remember to manually add the extra Health Regen and Skill Points from the My Character tab.

~Embracing Humanity~.Effect: You have extra Health Regen and Skill Points equal to double your Sense.
~Embracing Humanity~.Downside: Unlearning this Talent does remove the Skills and Health Regen added.

~Create Elixir~.Effect:
Choose 2 of the following types of elixirs and create one of each.
When consumed with Half-Action, each elixir has a different effect:
SingleTable: Elixir of Health: Heal for 2d6 Health
Elixir of Mana: Gain 1 Mana
Elixir of Strength: +1d4 Damage with first weapon attack each Turn
Elixir of Speed: +2 Movement Speed

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, remember to manually add the desired numbers from the My Character tab.

~Gene Editing~.Effect:
Use your tools to conduct a scientific experiment on a person (even yourself).
They get {Brown('-1 Sense')} but get a random upgrade permanently.
If used on yourself, you gain an extra +1 Health.
SingleTable: 1. +1 Might and +2 Max Health and veins glow in the dark
2. +1 Dexterity and +0.5 Initiative and skin tints to a color
3. +1 Intelligence and +3 Skill Points and eyes change color
4. +4 Health Regen and the inability to feel pain
5. +1 Health, Health Regen and Movement Speed, and +0.5 Initiative
6. The experiment fails and nothing else happens
~Gene Editing~.Notes: These changes are kept even if you change this Talent.

~Mechanical Precision~.Effect: Your next attack, if it's with the same metal weapon as the previous attack, deals exactly the same base weapon Damage.
~Mechanical Precision~.Notes:
Same Damage as after the attack's final Damage roll from the base weapon.
This attack does not trigger Critical Strikes.
If your last Gun attack dealt 11 Damage, use this and your next Gun attack will deal exactly 11 Damage.

~Spell Scroll~.Effect:
You create a special _scroll_.
An Ally (or you) casts a Spell on your _scroll_, which absorbs the spell before it takes effect.
The _scroll_ can be used with Half-Action, and is destroyed after being used.
~Spell Scroll~.Notes: You can only have one Spell Scroll created at a time.

<Reforge Weapon>.Effect: You reforge a weapon to provide 2 from the following benefits:
<Reforge Weapon>.Upgrade: Reforging it again changes the benefit.
SingleTable: +1 Damage (if One-Handed)
+1d4 Damage (if Two-Handed)
+1 Movement Speed while wielding it
Damage becomes Fire or Shock
Wielder starts Combat with a 1d6 Shielding.

Popup.Message: Once the mask is attacked, remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

~Iron Mask~.Effect:
Spend 150 {Gold}Gold to craft a special _mask_ that can be permanently attached to one's face.

Once attached, the wearer permanently get {Brown('-1 Sense')}, +8 Max Health, +2 Range on all Abilities and attacks, they are immune to being Blinded.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab.

~Body Augmentation~.Effect:
Perform a surgical augmentation to replace one of your biological limbs with a mechanized, gear-driven prosthesis.
Get {Brown('-1 Sense')} permanently.
Gain +2 Health and +1 in Might or Dexterity.
The extra Might or Dexterity can exceed your Stat Limit by up to 2.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

<Reforge Armor>.Effect: You reforge a set of body armor to provide 1 of the following benefits:
SingleTable: +4 Health
+2 Health Regen
+1 Movement Speed
+3 Initiative
-50% Damage Taken of a chosen non-physical Damage Type
<Reforge Armor>.Upgrade: An armor can only be reforged twice, to have up to 2 different benefits.
<Reforge Armor>.Notes:
After reforging twice, you can keep reforging an armor to change one of its benefits to a different one.
A reforged armor can't have 2 of the same Reforge Armor benefit at a time.

~Give In To Metal~.Effect: Gain a number of Action Points equal to the opposite of your Sense.
~Give In To Metal~.Notes: If your Sense is -2, you gain 2 Action Points.

<Create Golem>.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).
<Create Golem>.Effect:
Permanently get {Brown('-1 Sense')} and -1 Health Regen and craft a Golem that does your bidding.

It has Half-Action and takes its Turn on the same Turn as you. It has the Attack Ability, but you need to choose the material it's made out of.
<Create Golem>.Upgrade: Each additional Golem you craft takes -2 Health Regen more than the previous.
<Create Golem>.Notes:
If the Golem is destroyed, you can spend 10 minutes to repair it. You can change its type between Adventures.
The Golem can be stored as a smaller version of itself that expands at the beginning of the Combat, or when thrown somewhere for Half-Action.

~Attack~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike (Clay) - if you rolled 6, Single-Stun the target.
Critical Strike (Flesh) - if you rolled 6, +1d6 Damage.
Critical Strike (Metal) - if you rolled 6, deal the Damage to one more Unit near the target.

~Effect~.Effect:
Brown('Clay:') Enemies ending their Turn near the Clay Golem are Slowed.
Brown('Flesh:') Instead of attacking, pull a Unit up to 5 meters away next to the Golem (Once / Combat).
Brown('Metal:') Allies within 1 meter of the Metal Golem have Cover from Ranged attacks.
~Effect~.Notes: The Flesh Golem can use a hook to pull an enemy to the closest space near the Golem (requires clear path).

~Land Vehicle~.Effect:
Spend 2000 {Gold}Gold to engineer a multi-passenger transport vehicle. Maximum operational velocity is 100 km/h, consuming 50 {Gold} worth of fuel per hour, but it is impractical for combat.
Due to mechanical complexity, the vehicle requires 1 minute of calibration in order to start moving from being stationary.

~Transmute Rock~.Effect:
Select a 1x1x1 meter cube of rock, mud, sand, or similar material and transform it into a different material of similar composition, rarity and worth. A Unit caught in this effect becomes Slowed.
Once per Adventure, you can transmute a piece of metal you can hold in your hand into gold worth up to 400% its original worth in {Gold}Gold.

~Circle of Manifestation~.Effect:
Inscribe a grand alchemical glyph on a flat plane and make a wish, translating your intent into the circle through precise mathematical symbology.
When activating it with your palm, it initiates the transmutation of the inscribed wish into reality, but you pay an unknown cost proportional to your wish's value.

Make a Roll (2d6). The higher you roll, the more accurately you gain what you wished for.
~Circle of Manifestation~.Upgrade: On doubles, there may be complications or bonuses.

~Propulsion Backpack~.Effect:
Spend 400 {Gold}Gold to construct a specialized backpack which generates sustained lift when activated, allowing the user to achieve flight at their normal Speed for up to 1 hour.
The backpack is destroyed once exhausted.

<Alchemy>.Effect: You can use Create Elixir a number of ^extra^ times per Adventure equal to your Sense.

<Adrenaline Steroid>.Effect:
Enter a state of chemical surge until the end of your next Turn.
You get +100% healing on you (from any source) and all your offensive attacks and Abilities consume a Combo to increase their Damage by 100%.
<Adrenaline Steroid>.Notes: Does not work for after-Combat Health Regen.

<Inscription>.Effect: You can use Create Scroll a number of times per Adventure equal to your Sense.

<Create Replica>.Effect:
Fabricate a perfect replica of a non-legendary magic item.
Only one replica of that item can exist, and the previous one must be destroyed in order to use Create Replica again.

<Augmentation>.Effect:
You augment your body using chemical, mechanical or magical procedures.
Your Might and Dexterity increase by 2, your Health by 10

<Transfiguration>.Effect:
You replace your body entirely with magical constructs, and transfuse your mind and consciousness into a different part of your new transcendental body, which can be entirely biological or mechanical in nature.
Your Might and Dexterity increase by 4, your base Defense is 4, and you are Skilled when doing anything with Might, Dexterity or Intelligence.
You no longer age and you are immune to all diseases.

<Master Artifex>.Effect:
All potions and elixirs you create are 2 times as potent. Your Golems, Autoturrets and Grenades deal 100% more Damage.
Once per Adventure, you can create a Magic Item as per the _QM Resources, Homebrewing Magic Items_ page rules and spend Gold for the materials equal to half of the item's gold cost.

<Carbonic Reflection>.Effect:
You create a perfect clone of yourself, that can be biological or mechanical in nature. It resembles you identically in appearance, Stats, personality, etc.
It can cast any Abilities you have access to, but they share a Cooldown. You control both in Combat and they act on the same Turn.
Beware: The clone is intelligent, and while its goals are aligned with yours, it is not guaranteed to always listen to your commands and desires outside of Combat. You decide if its intelligence is natural or artificial, and if your clone is truly sentient or conscious or not.
